item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 03/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will affect southern China persistently in the next couple of days. The weather will be generally fine over the region. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea during the weekend and early next week. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong early next week. It will be dry during the day over the region midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Krathon will move across Taiwan today and weaken significantly.
